headerQuote: “The supplication of a Muslim for his brother in his absence is accepted.”
successDesc: It will be published after editor approval (usually 4-24 hours).
emptyFeed: No prayers online right now. Be the first to request one!
joinQuestion: Would you like to join the prayer brotherhood?
pendingHint: Editor approval usually takes 4-24 hours. Thank you for your patience 🤲
dailyLimitMsg: You have 2 prayer requests per day, and you've used today's.
dailyLimitSub: Your 2 daily prayer requests will automatically renew at midnight. See you tomorrow 🤲
profanitySub: This is a spiritual platform. Please use kind words when praying for your siblings.
submitError: An error occurred while submitting the prayer. Please try again.
deleteRequestSub: Shall we send a deletion request to the admin?
deleteRequestSuccessMsg: The prayer will be deleted after editor review.
updateError: An error occurred while updating the prayer.
paywallCreditNeeded: To request a prayer, {{cost}} credits are needed.
paywallEarnHint: Every time you say “Amin” you earn +1 credit!
paywallPremiumHint: or become Premium for unlimited prayers ✨
paywallSubtitle: Earn credits for the prayer community
paywallWatchAdDesc: Watch a short video, earn credits
formPrivacyNote: 💚 Prayer requests are shared with privacy and respect. Do not share names or personal information.
formPlaceholder: Write your prayer here... (e.g. I request prayers for health, peace, and blessings)
formCapsWarn: Your prayer is mostly in CAPITAL LETTERS. All caps reads like shouting — please use normal writing.
formCapsBlock: Your prayer is written entirely in CAPITAL LETTERS. Please rewrite it normally before sending.
historyEmpty: You have no prayer requests yet

amin.title: Say Amin, fill your jar
amin.body: Saying Amin to a brother's prayer joins you to it and adds +{{reward}} credit to your jar.
amin.bodyPremium: Saying Amin to a brother's prayer joins you to it. With Premium you don't need to collect credits.

credits.title: Your Amin jar
credits.body: Sending one prayer request costs {{cost}} credits. Collect them by saying Amin (+{{reward}}) or watching an ad (+{{adReward}}).

send.title: Ask for your own prayer
send.body: Write your prayer and send it. It is checked first, then shown in the public list — usually within 4-24 hours. You can send 2 a day.

history.title: Status of your requests
history.body: See where each request stands: awaiting approval or live. You can edit the text or ask for it to be removed.

reportText: Report content that is inappropriate or breaks the rules. The prayer will be hidden immediately.
